steps.title: Versatile and light
steps.body: Gamay's low tannin and fresh acidity make it very food-friendly. It suits charcuterie, roast chicken, salmon, pâté and Lyon's bistro food, like saucisson and andouillette. It handles light spice better than tannic reds. It's a great picnic wine.

steps.title: Service and age
steps.body: Serve slightly cool, 12 to 14 degrees; a little chill brings out its fruit. Nouveau within months; Beaujolais and Villages within two or three years. Structured crus, like Morgon and Moulin-à-Vent, can age 10 years or more, becoming more like Pinot Noir, a process called pinoter.

steps.explanation: A slight chill keeps its fruit lively.

steps.body: Aged Morgon and Moulin-à-Vent can taste surprisingly like Burgundy. Locals say the wine pinote, becomes Pinot-like, with age.

steps.prompt: Some Beaujolais crus can age 10 years or more.
steps.explanation: Yes. Morgon and Moulin-à-Vent are known for ageing well.

steps.title: What you learned
points: Gamay suits charcuterie, chicken and bistro food
Morgon and Moulin-à-Vent can age 10 years or more
